summary: In this Season 9 video, liveranov completes 300 pulls on the Targeted Summons banner featuring Longbeau, Fyrenzur, and Tallyn. He successfully pulls six legendaries: Longbeau, Huldork, Victor, Vinyara, Tamar, and the new Season 9 ice support hero Celestine. After reaching the 300-summon milestone, he asks viewers to help him choose between an inspiration copy of Longbeau, Fyrenzur for dodge support, or Tallyn for shields and stuns.
